title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Schedule of Benefit Limits
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver — Schedule of Benefit Limits

Claims schedule for the Kestrel GAP Waiver. It sets, for each of the six levels, how much of the loan is covered, how much of the primary insurance deductible is added, the most a waiver can pay, and who is paid and when.

## Per-level limits (amounts in USD)

| Level | Maximum loan-to-value covered | Deductible coverage | Maximum benefit per waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel GAP Essential | 115 percent | 0.00 | 25000.00 |
| Kestrel GAP Standard | 125 percent | 0.00 | 35000.00 |
| Kestrel GAP Plus | 125 percent | 500.00 | 50000.00 |
| Kestrel GAP Premier | 150 percent | 500.00 | 50000.00 |
| Kestrel GAP Premier Plus | 150 percent | 1000.00 | 75000.00 |
| Kestrel GAP Max | 175 percent | 1000.00 | 100000.00 |

- **Maximum loan-to-value covered** is a percent of the vehicle cash price. The loan balance is covered up to that loan-to-value; the share of the loan above it is not covered.
- **Deductible coverage** is the part of the primary insurance deductible added to the benefit. A level showing 0.00 adds no part of the deductible.
- **Maximum benefit per waiver** is the ceiling on the benefit.

## Limits common to every level

| Item | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Premier Plus | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Largest primary deductible recognized when adding deductible coverage | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 |
| Benefits payable per waiver | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Who receives the benefit | Lienholder | Lienholder | Lienholder | Lienholder | Lienholder | Lienholder |
| Benefit above the remaining balance paid to the borrower | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Benefit paid within, after approval | 10 business days | 10 business days | 10 business days | 10 business days | 10 business days | 10 business days |
| Status of the waiver once a benefit is paid | Claim settled | Claim settled | Claim settled | Claim settled | Claim settled | Claim settled |

## Notes on the schedule

- A primary deductible larger than 1000.00 is recognized only up to 1000.00 when deductible coverage is added.
- Each waiver pays one benefit. Once it is paid, the waiver's status becomes claim settled.
- The benefit is paid to the lienholder within 10 business days after approval; no part of a benefit above the remaining loan balance goes to the borrower.

### Example (hypothetical deductibles)

On a Kestrel GAP Premier Plus waiver (deductible coverage 1000.00), a primary deductible of 1500.00 is recognized as 1000.00. A primary deductible of 800.00 on any level is recognized in full, at 800.00.
